svg.title: V1 gate arrival
svg.desc: Eye height on the South Bridge looking north through the round-arched South Gate to the fountain and the cathedral west front; morning light.

g.text: auction lantern 34 m · dome 30 m, Ø 28 m
South Gate 18 m · round arch 8 m
GD / V1 ARRIVAL / THE GATE FRAMES THE TOWN
South Bridge deck (0, −148), eye 1.65 m, looking north · bridge → slum roofs → 10 m wall → round-arched South Gate (48 m) → spine → fountain (148 m) → cathedral west front (196 m).

Composed view: everything beyond the wall is drawn at compressed depth (≈0.35×) so landmark tops read over the 10 m wall; heights keep the ladder. Retest true occlusion in the V1 Editor capture. River runs beneath the deck.
CONCEPT / NOVEMBER 2026 • PROPOSED, NOT AN ENGINE CAPTURE • MORNING, LOW SUN FROM UPPER LEFT • NO DOCKS · ROUND ARCHES OFF THE CATHEDRAL
